brief: Craft over hustle: 6 things makers know that hustlers don't.

slots.scriptTagline: Slow hands build what speed forgets.

slots.body: Hustlers glorify exhaustion. Makers know that recovery fuels clarity and sharpens the work. Rest is not a reward; it is a requirement.
Hustlers broadcast every move. Makers build in silence, letting drafts stay messy until the idea is truly ready. The process is sacred, not content.
One masterful piece outlives a hundred rushed posts. Makers chase mastery in a single direction while hustlers scatter for reach. Choose the narrow path.
Hustlers chase the latest gear. Makers know that constraint breeds invention and a practiced hand outperforms any plugin. Skill is the only software.
Growth is not the only metric. Makers protect the integrity of the work, even if it means staying small. Quality creates its own gravity.
Hustlers live for the dashboard. Makers build for the archive, knowing that timeless work speaks louder than trending noise. Let the numbers fade.
